name: openreturn
description: OpenReturn monorepo. canon is Canon, the tax attorney (reference corpus, retrieval, Ask The Tax Code, grounding judges; a Mastra project with an MCP server); cade is Cade, the AI CPA (Mastra); web is the Next.js frontend; engine is the form engine and engine/builder the dev-time tools that build its assets; sources holds the IRS/FTB source documents by tax year. canon, cade, engine, engine/builder and sources are npm workspaces; web installs on its own.

scripts.reset: npm --prefix cade run reset:data && npm --prefix canon run reset:data
scripts.test:unit: npm -w @openreturn/engine run test:unit && npm -w canon run test:unit && npm -w cade run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm -w @openreturn/engine run test:integration && npm -w cade run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @openreturn/engine run typecheck && npm -w @openreturn/builder run typecheck && npm -w canon run typecheck && npm -w cade run typecheck
